name: U_universal
description: The universal model (ARCHITECTURE.md, tasks 00023-00024) and its world, the defaults for universal-model experiments: 8x8 grayscale patch tokens (one channel), 32 bins, fully causal next-token prediction, one head, nothing detached; acting by its own move prediction plus the hunger instinct (16 candidates), no babbling, no command; memory U. The world: a continual torus in grayscale, food (a solid disc) relieves hunger on a click, poison (a checkerboard disc) adds 0.5 on a click, contact costs nothing, slow hunger, 8 moving grey dots.
